title: The Tyvaren Ultimatum
description: Marshal Vukov has issued a public ultimatum: cede the Gravenmark Pass or face consequences. You have four weeks to respond. This is the most consequential decision of your Chancellorship.

title: Budget Allocation — Pre-Crisis Review
description: With Tyvaren escalating, your budget priorities may need to shift. Review allocations before the crisis constrains your options.

title: Diplomatic Options — International Forum
description: Foreign Minister Volkov has secured an emergency session at the International Forum. The Strevna neutral territory is available for talks. The question is whether Vukov will negotiate — or whether he's already decided.

title: Military Readiness — Full Assessment
description: Dusek and Brenner have prepared a joint assessment. It covers force ratios, mobilization timelines, logistical constraints, and the question neither of them will answer directly: can we win?

title: Dravenni — Alliance or Insurgency
description: The Dravenni Liberation Front has made contact through intermediaries. They want to know whether Veltria will honor their autonomy or suppress it. Their answer to Vukov depends on your answer to them.

title: Economic Mobilization — Preliminary Framework
description: War requires a different economy. Vostane has modeled the transition costs. The IMA conditions don't account for artillery purchases. Something will have to give.
